review_candidates.description: Company Description HelpRush is a real-time marketplace for local services, operated by Horfay Taqnia Private Limited, a DPIIT-recognised startup founded by Dr. Fayyaz Muhammad and Tabinda Noor. The platform uses patented parallel dispatch technology to connect customers with verified professionals in under five seconds, improving speed and reliability of service delivery. HelpRush enforces trust and quality through Aadhaar/PAN-based identity checks, a five-stage Skill Verification Engine, and live trust and risk engines that govern job allocation. The company supports immediate jobs, scheduled appointments, and multi-day projects with escrowed milestone payments, creating transparent engagements for both customers and professionals. HelpRush is currently bootstrapped and live in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, where it is recommended as an onboarding pathway for PM Vishwakarma beneficiaries. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Customer Support Executive role based in Srinagar. The Customer Support Executive will handle incoming inquiries from customers and service professionals via phone, chat, and email, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of issues. Responsibilities include guiding users through the HelpRush app and processes, troubleshooting basic technical and account-related problems, and escalating complex issues to the appropriate internal teams. The role also involves monitoring active jobs, supporting smooth dispatch and booking workflows, maintaining detailed case records, and providing feedback to improve support procedures and user experience. The Customer Support Executive will collaborate closely with operations and product teams to uphold high standards of service quality and customer satisfaction. Qualifications Strong customer-facing skills, including Customer Support, Customer Service, and Customer Satisfaction. Experience providing Online Support through phone, chat, or email channels. Ability to deliver basic Technical Support, including app navigation, account assistance, and troubleshooting common user issues. Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage. Comfort with using CRM tools or ticketing systems, and proficiency with common office and collaboration software. Proven ability to stay calm under pressure, manage multiple queries, and maintain a problem-solving mindset. Prior experience in customer support, operations, or service marketplaces is preferred but not mandatory. Minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in any discipline is an added advantage.

Experience testing IoT, utilities, or smart metering solutions is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Senior AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Requirements: - Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience building, fine-tuning, deploying, and operating AI/ML systems in production environments. - Minimum 3+ years of professional experience using Python, with strong object-oriented programming skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-grade code. - Hands-on experience with open-source and open-weight LLMs including OpenAI GPT-OSS, LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral, and similar transformer-based models. - Strong understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, tokenization strategies, and context window management. - Strong hands-on experience with PyTorch and TensorFlow, the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Accelerate), and high-performance LLM inference frameworks including vLLM, Triton Inference Server, and Text Generation Inference (TGI). - Experience with integrating in-memory data stores such as Redis for vector search and retrieval-augmented generation tasks. Job Responsibilities: - Design, build, fine-tune, and operate end-to-end AI systems using Large Language Models (LLMs) for real production use cases, covering model selection, training workflows, inference optimization, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Fine-tune and adapt LLMs using instruction tuning, domain adaptation, and parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, adapters), ensuring model quality, stability, and performance. - Design and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including embedding models, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), semantic search, chunking strategies, retrieval quality optimization, and grounding techniques. - Develop and serve AI models as standalone AI services exposed via REST / gRPC APIs, optimized for latency, throughput, and cost using batching, quantization, and model parallelism. - Own AI deployment and lifecycle management in production, including versioning, rollback strategies, monitoring (latency, drift, failure modes, cost), and safe model iteration. - Deploy and operate LLMs across environments, using managed AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and self-hosted open-source models on cloud GPU infrastructure (AWS EC2, Azure VMs, GCP Compute), with CI/CD integration for automated deployment and model versioning.

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Integration Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate brings strong technical leadership, an innovative and forward-thinking mindset, and a passion for driving impactful initiatives. You will be part of an agile, international team, designing and developing scalable integrations, automations, and applications that seamlessly connect systems across cloud and hybrid environments. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Design, develop and manage integrations using modern iPaaS platforms (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, N8N, others). Design, develop and maintain enterprise applications built with TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot, SAP CAP, Fiori, SAPUI5 within cloud-native environments - SAP BTP Cloud Foundry, Azure, AWS. Implement integrations leveraging diverse communication protocols including HTTP, OData, SOAP, GraphQL, REST, IDoc, SFTP. Design and implement end-to-end automated workflows that orchestrate tasks across multiple enterprise systems. Drive end-to-end software development using AI-augmented platforms, specializing in integration solutions. Act as a technical expert, ensuring quality and continuous AI generation process improvement from initial analysis through to deployment and ongoing ownership. Collaborate with stakeholders, project managers, product owners, and engineering teams to define and deliver robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within teams. Adherence and advocate for best practices, ensuring technical integrity, high delivery quality and long-term maintainability of solutions. WHAT YOU WILL NEED: Strong proficiency in Full-Stack software development with Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, TypeScript, Groovy, OSGi. Strong hands-on experience with major enterprise integration platforms (e.g SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, Boomi, WebMethods, N8N or similar) Experience with cloud-to-on-premise integrations and hybrid landscapes through various protocols (e.g HTTP, OData, SOAP, REST, IDoc, SFTP). Experience with relational and non-relational database design (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB) Experience with integrating ERP/CRM systems. Strong understanding of authentication and security standards (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, TLS). Solid understanding of API-based architectures, event-driven architecture, message queues, and enterprise integration patterns. Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Passion for innovation, automation, and delivering high-quality software. Fluent in English. NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS: Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in building intelligent, context-aware enterprise solutions. Experience with Rapid Application Development (Low-Code / No-Code / Pro-Code ) tools. Familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, Gitlab Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.). Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes). Multiple Office Locations: in Sofia, Plovdiv, Stara Zagora, and Nis, you choose where you would like to work. Community and Connections: Engage in exciting social events and team initiatives. Empowerment: At Wiser, every role is instrumental. You will have the power to make a difference! Wiser, We Have The Code®
